metadata.title: Southeast Asia Oil Palm Multi-Model Conviction & Consensus Intelligence

territories.name: Perlis
territories.diagnosis: Strong internal consistency: EC Hybrid (10.2 mm/day) aligns closely with the 50-member ensemble mean (10.7 mm/day). Wide ensemble dispersion (P20–P80: 4.5–14.9 mm/day; spread 10.5 mm/day) reflects high convective uncertainty. High cross-model conviction: ECMWF 50-ENS (10.7 mm/day) and NOAA 31-GEFS (10.5 mm/day) are in tight ensemble consensus (delta +0.2 mm/day). Moderate Harvesting Impact: Wet estate conditions (10.2 mm/day) with periodic afternoon downpours; minor delays in FFB transport, though soil moisture replenishment remains favorable.
